subject.title: fix(tools): surface empty availability group diagnostics via onHiddenDiagnostic callback

question: Should maintainers accept this PR as the canonical warn-only fix for malformed plugin tool availability diagnostics, or choose a narrower sibling implementation for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/92361?
rationale: The code review found no concrete defect, but the patch changes plugin-facing metadata handling from ignored to preserved-and-warned, and that compatibility/product choice cannot be settled by automation alone.

options.title: Accept this warn-only path
options.body: Use this PR as the canonical implementation after exact-head gates, accepting that malformed availability-like plugin metadata now emits authoring warnings while tool visibility stays unchanged.

options.title: Pick a narrower sibling
options.body: Pause or close this PR if maintainers prefer a smaller competing implementation that only changes the planner or only changes descriptor registration.

options.title: Require stricter semantics
options.body: Ask for a revised PR if maintainers want malformed plugin availability to fail closed or hide tools instead of remaining warning-only.

recommendation.title: Accept this warn-only path
recommendation.body: Use this PR as the canonical implementation after exact-head gates, accepting that malformed availability-like plugin metadata now emits authoring warnings while tool visibility stays unchanged.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history on the plugin descriptor cache and plugin resolver boundary where the compatibility decision lands.
